title: D-024 A1: live baseline, installed-capability probes, deterministic fixtures
objective: Reconcile the live workstation repository (linked worktrees, dirty/unpushed state, remotes; imported-snapshot findings labeled historical until done); map current components and safely reusable behavior (D-007 Codex bridge, D-010 supervisor, D-023 bounded mode/reliability/turnover) into a reuse register and compact baseline (implemented+verified / present-but-unproven / missing / conflicting); probe the installed claude and codex CLI capabilities (subagentStatusLine, UserPromptExpansion, exact UserPromptSubmit block/display/context-erasure behavior, status-line fields, hook events, strict MCP configuration equivalents) against local help and official primary docs (source section 21), never inferring support from repository references; record probe results as deterministic fixtures distinguishing supported/unsupported/nullable/unknown; add deterministic fixtures for current state, event formats, and failure cases BEFORE any control-behavior change. Amend .claude/rules/supervisor-freeze.md transparently under D-024 authority so a cited D-024 requirement ID is recognized qualifying evidence for supervisor tasks (source section 1 freeze clause); this task itself only adds fixtures/probe tooling and changes no supervisor control behavior. Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R099 (Phase A capability fixtures) and the section-1 freeze clause; cite in commit messages.
business_reason: D-024 owner directive 2026-08-24 Phase A: no control-behavior change may precede capability fixtures; live probes are required because absence from a repository snapshot is not proof of absence (D-024-R001).
outputs: tools/agent_supervisor/fixtures/* capability-probe fixture pack (supported/unsupported/nullable/unknown per installed version)
